text: Level three, question six: A starts a business with fifty-four thousand rupees; some months later, B joins with seventy-two thousand; at the end of the year, the profit is shared in the ratio three to two; after how many months did B join? Question seven: A invests sixty thousand rupees for the whole year, and B joins after four months; of a profit of forty-five thousand, B receives twenty thousand; how much did B invest? Question eight: A starts a business with forty thousand rupees; B joins after three months with sixty thousand, and C joins six months after B with one lakh twenty thousand; the year's profit is sixty-nine thousand; find each share.
